description.en-US:
Control your Apple TV right from your Mac's menu bar. Apple TV Remote puts a full-featured Siri Remote on your desktop, always one click away.

Features:
• One-click access from the menu bar
• Auto-discovers Apple TVs on your network
• Full D-pad with press-and-hold support
• Playback controls (Play/Pause, Next, Previous)
• Volume control
• Menu, Home, and Sleep buttons
• Secure pairing with PIN code
• Auto-connects when only one Apple TV is found
